# Hook configuration for aiu-shell-jump.
#

{% if hook == InitHook::None -%}
{{ not_configured }}

{%- else -%}
# Initialize hook to add new entries to the database.
export-env {
{%- if hook == InitHook::Prompt %}
  $env.config = (
    $env.config?
    | default {}
    | upsert hooks { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.pre_prompt { default [] }
  )
  let __aiu_shell_jump_hooked = (
    $env.config.hooks.pre_prompt | any { try { get __aiu_shell_jump_hook } catch { false } }
  )
  if not $__aiu_shell_jump_hooked {
    $env.config.hooks.pre_prompt = ($env.config.hooks.pre_prompt | append {
      __aiu_shell_jump_hook: true,
      code: {|| ^aiu-shell-jump add -- $env.PWD}
    })
  }
{%- else if hook == InitHook::Pwd %}
  $env.config = (
    $env.config?
    | default {}
    | upsert hooks { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.env_change { default {} }
    | upsert hooks.env_change.PWD { default [] }
  )
  let __aiu_shell_jump_hooked = (
    $env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD | any { try { get __aiu_shell_jump_hook } catch { false } }
  )
  if not $__aiu_shell_jump_hooked {
    $env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD = ($env.config.hooks.env_change.PWD | append {
      __aiu_shell_jump_hook: true,
      code: {|_, dir| ^aiu-shell-jump add -- $dir}
    })
  }
{%- endif %}
}

{%- endif %}

{{ section }}
# When using aiu-shell-jump with --no-cmd, alias these internal functions as desired.
#

# Jump to a directory using only keywords.
export def --env --wrapped __aiu_shell_jump_z [...rest: directory] {
  let path = match $rest {
    [] => {'~'},
    [ '-' ] => {'-'},
    [ $arg ] if ($arg | path expand | path type) == 'dir' => {$arg}
    _ => {
      ^aiu-shell-jump query --exclude $env.PWD -- ...$rest | str trim -r -c "\n"
    }
  }
  cd $path
{%- if echo %}
  echo $env.PWD
{%- endif %}
}

# Jump to a directory using interactive search.
export def --env --wrapped __aiu_shell_jump_zi [...rest: string] {
  cd $'(^aiu-shell-jump query --interactive -- ...$rest | str trim -r -c "\n")'
{%- if echo %}
  echo $env.PWD
{%- endif %}
}

{{ section }}
# Commands for aiu-shell-jump. Disable these using --no-cmd.
#

{%- match cmd %}
{%- when Some with (cmd) %}

export alias {{cmd}} = __aiu_shell_jump_z
export alias {{cmd}}i = __aiu_shell_jump_zi

{%- when None %}

{{ not_configured }}

{%- endmatch %}

# Add this to your env file (find it by running `$nu.env-path` in Nushell):
#
#   aiu-shell-jump init nushell | save -f ~/.aiu-shell-jump.nu
#
# Now, add this to the end of your config file (find it by running
# `$nu.config-path` in Nushell):
#
#   source ~/.aiu-shell-jump.nu
#
# Note: aiu-shell-jump only supports Nushell v0.89.0+.
